name: devspec
description: Connect Claude Code to DevSpec: pull a batch of action items and work them, and drive sessions from the Agents page.

devspec_token.title: DevSpec API token
devspec_token.description: Your DevSpec API token with read_write scope. Create one in DevSpec under You → Connections → Connect a tool (pick Read & write). It starts with 'dvs_' and is account-wide — reuse the same token everywhere.

devspec_mcp_url.title: DevSpec server
devspec_mcp_url.description: Leave this as it is. It only changes if DevSpec ask you to point at a different server.
